channel.title: SuiKit Blog — Engineering notes
channel.description: DeepBook V3 on Sui — implementation notes from a bot that actually trades.

item.title: DeepBook V3 BalanceManager — free vs locked vs settled, and where your balance actually is
item.description: Your balance lives in three states — free, locked, settled — and reading only one is how bots lose track of their own money. The settled-sweep pattern that fixes it.

item.title: DeepBook V3 MoveAbort code 3 — the silent pay_with_deep failure every bot hits
item.description: Your limit order aborts with MoveAbort code 3 and no useful message. It is almost always an insufficient or locked DEEP fee balance — how to detect it and the pay_with_deep=false fallback.

item.title: Sui deprecated public JSON-RPC — migrating payment verification to GraphQL
item.description: Public JSON-RPC on Sui fullnodes was deprecated. The exact GraphQL migration that kept on-chain USDC payment verification working — queries, gotchas, and code.

item.title: What is SuiKit — and how to buy it
item.description: A source-available development kit for DeepBook V3 on Sui. What you get, what it is not, and the step-by-step purchase flow.
